button_url.label: Button Link URL
button_url.description: Input the destination URL for your button.

url_new_window.label: Button Link Target
url_new_window.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window

button_alignment.label: Button Alignment
button_alignment.description: Here you can define the alignment of Button

disabled_on.label: Disable on
disabled_on.description: This will disable the module on selected devices

admin_label.label: Admin Label
admin_label.description: This will change the label of the module in the builder for easy identification.

module_id.label: CSS ID
module_id.description: Assign a unique CSS ID to the element which can be used to assign custom CSS styles from within your child theme or from within Divi's custom CSS inputs.

module_class.label: CSS Class
module_class.description: Assign any number of CSS Classes to the element, separated by spaces, which can be used to assign custom CSS styles from within your child theme or from within Divi's custom CSS inputs.

custom_button.label: Use Custom Styles For Button
custom_button.description: If you would like to customize the appearance of this module's button, you must first enable custom button styles.

button_text_size.label: Button Text Size
button_text_size.description: Increase or decrease the size of the button text.

button_text_color.label: Button Text Color
button_text_color.description: Pick a color to be used for the button text.

button_bg_color.label: Button Background
button_bg_color.description: Adjust the background style of the button by customizing the background color, gradient, and image.

button_bg_color_gradient_repeat.label: Repeat Gradient
button_bg_color_gradient_repeat.description: If enabled, defined gradient stops will be repeated until the outer boundary of the background is reached.

button_bg_color_gradient_type.label: Gradient Type
button_bg_color_gradient_type.description: Linear gradients radiate in a single direction across one axis. Radial gradients radiate from the center of the background in the shape of a circle.

button_bg_color_gradient_direction.label: Gradient Direction
button_bg_color_gradient_direction.description: Change the direction of the gradient by choosing a starting position within a 360 degree range.

button_bg_color_gradient_direction_radia.label: Gradient Position
button_bg_color_gradient_direction_radia.description: Change the direction of the gradient by choosing a starting position within a 360 degree range.

button_bg_color_gradient_stops.label: Gradient Stops
button_bg_color_gradient_stops.description: Add two or more color stops to your gradient background. Each stop can be dragged to any position on the gradient bar. From each color stop to the next the color is interpolated into a smooth gradient.

button_bg_color_gradient_unit.label: Gradient Unit
button_bg_color_gradient_unit.description: Define the units of your gradient stop positions.

button_bg_color_gradient_overlays_image.label: Place Gradient Above Background Image
button_bg_color_gradient_overlays_image.description: If enabled, gradient will be positioned on top of background-image

button_bg_color_gradient_start_position.label: Start Position
button_bg_color_gradient_start_position.description: By adjusting the starting position of the gradient, you can control how quickly or slowly each color transitions, and where the transition begins.

button_bg_color_gradient_end_position.label: End Position
button_bg_color_gradient_end_position.description: By adjusting the ending position of the gradient, you can control how quickly or slowly each color transitions, and where the transition begins.

button_bg_parallax.label: Use Parallax Effect
button_bg_parallax.description: If enabled, your background image will stay fixed as your scroll, creating a fun parallax-like effect.

button_bg_parallax_method.label: Parallax Method
button_bg_parallax_method.description: Define the method, used for the parallax effect.

button_bg_size.label: Background Image Size
button_bg_size.description: Choosing "Cover" will force the image to fill the entire background area, clipping the image when necessary. Choosing "Fit" will ensure that the entire image is always visible, but can result in blank spaces around the image. When set to "Actual Size," the image will not be resized at all.

button_bg_position.label: Background Image Position
button_bg_position.description: Choose where you would like the background image to be positioned within this element. You may want to position the background based on the the image's focus point.

button_bg_repeat.label: Background Image Repeat
button_bg_repeat.description: If the background image is smaller than the size of the element, you may want the image to repeat. This result will result in a background image pattern.

button_bg_blend.label: Background Image Blend
button_bg_blend.description: Background images can be blended with the background color, merging the two and creating unique effects.

button_bg_video_mp4.label: Background Video MP4
button_bg_video_mp4.description: All videos should be uploaded in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers. Upload the .MP4 version here.
button_bg_video_mp4.choose_text: Choose a Background Video MP4 File

button_bg_video_webm.label: Background Video Webm
button_bg_video_webm.description: All videos should be uploaded in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers. Upload the .WEBM version here.
button_bg_video_webm.choose_text: Choose a Background Video WEBM File

button_bg_video_width.label: Background Video Width
button_bg_video_width.description: In order for videos to be sized correctly, you must input the exact width (in pixels) of your video here.

button_bg_video_height.label: Background Video Height
button_bg_video_height.description: In order for videos to be sized correctly, you must input the exact height (in pixels) of your video here.

button_bg_allow_player_pause.label: Pause Video When Another Video Plays
button_bg_allow_player_pause.description: Allow video to be paused by other players when they begin playing

button_bg_video_pause_outside_viewport.label: Pause Video While Not In View
button_bg_video_pause_outside_viewport.description: Allow video to be paused while it is not in the visible area.

button_border_width.label: Button Border Width
button_border_width.description: Increase or decrease the thickness of the border around the button. Setting this value to 0 will remove the border entirely.

button_border_color.label: Button Border Color
button_border_color.description: Pick a color to be used for the button border.

button_border_radius.label: Button Border Radius
button_border_radius.description: Increasing the border radius will increase the roundness of the button's corners. Setting this value to 0 will result in squared corners.

button_letter_spacing.label: Button Letter Spacing
button_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing adjusts the distance between each letter in the button.

button_font.label: Button Font
button_font.description: Choose a custom font to use for the button. All Google web fonts are available, or you can upload your own custom font files.

button_use_icon.label: Show Button Icon
button_use_icon.description: When enabled, this will add a custom icon within the button.

button_icon.label: Button Icon
button_icon.description: Pick an icon to be used for the button.

button_icon_color.label: Button Icon Color
button_icon_color.description: Here you can define a custom color for the button icon.

button_icon_placement.label: Button Icon Placement
button_icon_placement.description: Choose where the button icon should be displayed within the button.

button_on_hover.label: Only Show Icon On Hover for Button
button_on_hover.description: By default, button icons are displayed on hover. If you would like button icons to always be displayed, then you can enable this option.

button_rel.label: Button Relationship
button_rel.description:
Specify the value of your link's rel attribute. The rel attribute specifies the relationship between the current document and the linked document.
Tip: Search engines can use this attribute to get more information about a link.

transform_styles.label: Transform
transform_styles.description: Using the transform controls, you can performance visual adjustments to any element using a combination of Scale, Translation, Rotation and Skew settings. This allows you to create advanced design effects without the need of a separate graphic design program.

positioning.label: Position
positioning.description: Here you can choose the element's position type. Absolutlely positioned elements will float inside their parent elements. Fixed positioned elements will float within the browser viewport. Relatively positioned elements sit statically in their parent container, but can still be offset without disrupting surrounding elements.

position_origin_a.label: Location
position_origin_a.description: Here you can adjust the element's starting location within its parent container. You can further adjust the element's position using the offset controls.

position_origin_f.label: Location
position_origin_f.description: Here you can adjust the element's starting location within its parent container. You can further adjust the element's position using the offset controls.

position_origin_r.label: Offset Origin
position_origin_r.description: Here you can choose from which corner this element is offset from. The vertical and horizontal offset adjustments will be affected based on the element's offset origin.

vertical_offset.label: Vertical Offset
vertical_offset.description: Here you can adjust the element's position upwards or downwards from its starting location, which may differ based on its offset origin.

horizontal_offset.label: Horizontal Offset
horizontal_offset.description: Here you can adjust the element's position left or right from its starting location, which may differ based on its offset origin.

z_index.label: Z Index
z_index.description: Here you can control element position on the z axis. Elements with higher z-index values will sit atop elements with lower z-index values.

background_layout.label: Text Color
background_layout.description: Here you can choose whether your text should be light or dark. If you are working with a dark background, then your text should be light. If your background is light, then your text should be set to dark.

overflow-x.label: Horizontal Overflow
overflow-x.description: Here you can control element overflow on the X axis. If set to scroll, content that overflows static widths or heights will trigger a browser scrollbar. If set to hidden, content overflow will be clipped.

overflow-y.label: Vertical Overflow
overflow-y.description: Here you can control element overflow on the Y axis. If set to scroll, content that overflows static widths or heights will trigger a browser scrollbar. If set to hidden, content overflow will be clipped.

display_conditions.label: Display Conditions
display_conditions.description: Choose when to display this element based on a set of conditions. Multiple conditions can be added. Date & Time condition is based on your timezone settings in your WordPress General Settings

custom_margin.label: Margin
custom_margin.description: Margin adds extra space to the outside of the element, increasing the distance between the element and other items on the page.

custom_padding.label: Padding
custom_padding.description: Padding adds extra space to the inside of the element, increasing the distance between the edge of the element and its inner contents.

filter_hue_rotate.label: Hue
filter_hue_rotate.description: Shift all colors by this amount.

filter_saturate.label: Saturation
filter_saturate.description: Define how intense the color saturation should be.

filter_brightness.label: Brightness
filter_brightness.description: Define how bright the colors should be.

filter_contrast.label: Contrast
filter_contrast.description: Define how distinct bright and dark areas should be.

filter_invert.label: Invert
filter_invert.description: Invert the hue, saturation, and brightness by this amount.

filter_sepia.label: Sepia
filter_sepia.description: Travel back in time by this amount.

filter_opacity.label: Opacity
filter_opacity.description: Define how transparent or opaque this should be.

mix_blend_mode.label: Blend Mode
mix_blend_mode.description: Modify how this element blends with any layers beneath it. To reset, choose the "Normal" option.

animation_style.label: Animation Style
animation_style.description: Pick an animation style to enable animations for this element. Once enabled, you will be able to customize your animation style further. To disable animations, choose the None option.

animation_direction.label: Animation Direction
animation_direction.description: Pick from up to five different animation directions, each of which will adjust the starting and ending position of your animated element.

animation_duration.label: Animation Duration
animation_duration.description: Speed up or slow down your animation by adjusting the animation duration. Units are in milliseconds and the default animation duration is one second.

animation_delay.label: Animation Delay
animation_delay.description: If you would like to add a delay before your animation runs you can designate that delay here in milliseconds. This can be useful when using multiple animated modules together.

animation_intensity_slide.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_slide.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_zoom.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_zoom.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_flip.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_flip.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_fold.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_fold.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_intensity_roll.label: Animation Intensity
animation_intensity_roll.description: Intensity effects how subtle or aggressive your animation will be. Lowering the intensity will create a smoother and more subtle animation while increasing the intensity will create a snappier more aggressive animation.

animation_starting_opacity.label: Animation Starting Opacity
animation_starting_opacity.description: By increasing the starting opacity, you can reduce or remove the fade effect that is applied to all animation styles.

animation_speed_curve.label: Animation Speed Curve
animation_speed_curve.description: Here you can adjust the easing method of your animation. Easing your animation in and out will create a smoother effect when compared to a linear speed curve.

animation_repeat.label: Animation Repeat
animation_repeat.description: By default, animations will only play once. If you would like to loop your animation continuously you can choose the Loop option here.

hover_transition_duration.label: Transition Duration
hover_transition_duration.description: This controls the transition duration of the hover animation.

hover_transition_delay.label: Transition Delay
hover_transition_delay.description: This controls the transition delay of the hover animation.

hover_transition_speed_curve.label: Transition Speed Curve
hover_transition_speed_curve.description: This controls the transition speed curve of the hover animation.

sticky_position.label: Sticky Position
sticky_position.description: Choose to have this element remain a fixed distance from the top or bottom edge of the browser window as the user scrolls

sticky_offset_top.label: Sticky Top Offset
sticky_offset_top.description: Define the vertical offset distance from the top edge of the browser window

sticky_offset_bottom.label: Sticky Bottom Offset
sticky_offset_bottom.description: Define the vertical offset distance from the bottom edge of the browser window

sticky_limit_top.label: Top Sticky Limit
sticky_limit_top.description: If defined, this element will stick to the top of this container, overriding its stickiness edge of the browser

sticky_limit_bottom.label: Bottom Sticky Limit
sticky_limit_bottom.description: If defined, this element will stick to the bottom of this container, overriding its stickiness to the edge of the browser

sticky_offset_surrounding.label: Offset From Surrounding Sticky Elements
sticky_offset_surrounding.description: Apply “Sticky Offset” to the nearest Sticky Element above or below this element

sticky_transition.label: Transition Default and Sticky Styles
sticky_transition.description: Enabled animated transitions between default and sticky styles when the element becomes “stuck”

scroll_effects.label: Scroll Transform Effects
scroll_effects.description: Using Scrolling Effects, you can transform elements on your page as you scroll. The animation's transition is based on the user's scrolling behavior. Once the element enters the browser viewport (top), the animation begins, and it once it leaves the viewport (bottom), the animation ends.

scroll_vertical_motion_enable.label: Enable Vertical Motion
scroll_vertical_motion_enable.description: Give this element vertical motion so that is moves faster or slower than the elements around it as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_vertical_motion.label: Set Vertical Motion
scroll_vertical_motion.description: Give this element vertical motion so that is moves faster or slower than the elements around it as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_horizontal_motion_enable.label: Enable Horizontal Motion
scroll_horizontal_motion_enable.description: Give this element horizontal motion so that it slides left or right as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_horizontal_motion.label: Set Horizontal Motion
scroll_horizontal_motion.description: Give this element horizontal motion so that it slides left or right as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_fade_enable.label: Enable Fading In and Out
scroll_fade_enable.description: Give this element an opacity effect so that it fades in and out as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_fade.label: Set Fading In and Out
scroll_fade.description: Give this element an opacity effect so that it fades in and out as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_scaling_enable.label: Enable Scaling Up and Down
scroll_scaling_enable.description: Give this element a scale effect so that it grows and shrinks as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_scaling.label: Set Scaling Up and Down
scroll_scaling.description: Give this element a scale effect so that it grows and shrinks as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_rotating_enable.label: Enable Rotating
scroll_rotating_enable.description: Give this element rotating motion so that it spins as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_rotating.label: Set Rotating
scroll_rotating.description: Give this element rotating motion so that it spins as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_blur_enable.label: Enable Blur
scroll_blur_enable.description: Give this element a blur effect so that it moves in and out of focus as the viewer scrolls through the page.

scroll_blur.label: Set Blur
scroll_blur.description: Give this element a blur effect so that it moves in and out of focus as the viewer scrolls through the page.

motion_trigger_start.label: Motion Effect Trigger
motion_trigger_start.description: Here you can choose when motion effects are triggered: When the top of the element enters into view, when the middle of the element enters into view, or when the bottom of the element enters into view.
